name: Find member by last name
description: Looks up a member by last name in MERIDIAN CORE, returning the member number, name and share count shown on the inquiry results row. Reports MULTIPLE_MATCHES if the search is not unique.

inputParams.name: lastName
inputParams.description: Member surname, or part of it, to search for.

outputs.name: memberId
outputs.description: Extract Member No. from matching row

outputs.name: shareCount
outputs.description: Extract Shares count from matching row
